# Known-failing tests, and why they are tolerated.
#
# These fail on a clean checkout of `main` and are unrelated to any current
# work. They are listed here so a test run can be judged: anything failing that
# is NOT in this list is new and yours; anything in it was already broken.
#
# Read by .github/scripts/check-test-failures.mjs. Run it locally — there is no
# CI in this repository.
#
# This file is a debt register, not a permission slip. Fixing an entry means
# deleting the line; if a line stops matching, the checker says so and the line
# should go.
#
# Verified 2026-09-05 by stashing the entire working tree (`git stash push -u`)
# and running the suites on the clean checkout: identical suites, identical
# test names.
#
# Format: one full test name per line, matched exactly against the reported
# failure. Blank lines and `#` comments ignored.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Page-tool specs (5 suites, 11 tests)
#
# All five construct their tool directly and mock PageService. They throw
# NotFoundException where the test expects ForbiddenException, which suggests
# the mocked page lookup stopped returning what the specs assume. Unrelated to
# the ConqrPlan integration: none of them import a file it touches.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

GetPageTool > returns page content for an accessible page
GetPageTool > throws ForbiddenException when user lacks Read access
GetPageTool > passes the requesting user to SpaceAbilityFactory

GetPageCommentsTool > returns comments for an accessible page
GetPageCommentsTool > throws ForbiddenException when user lacks Read access

GetPageHistoryTool > returns history entries for an accessible page
GetPageHistoryTool > throws ForbiddenException when user lacks Read access

ListChildPagesTool > lists child pages of a given parent
ListChildPagesTool > passes parentPageId to getSidebarPages
ListChildPagesTool > throws ForbiddenException when user cannot read

UpdateCommentTool > updates a comment with plain text
